_doc: scripts/check_widget_kind_dispatch.py for what this gates and why.
A row excuses ONE port failing to dispatch ONE kind, and needs a NON-EMPTY
reason -- a blank one excuses nothing (self-test case (d)). Keyed
Two classes live here and they are not alike:
* the SENTINEL, which no port should ever dispatch;
* REAL GAPS, scheduled but unbuilt. Each of those is a feature JasSwift
does not have, and the missing dispatch arm is its most visible
Removing a row is how you claim a kind is done. Do not remove one until
the ACTIONS its behaviour dispatches also exist in that port -- an arm
alone ships a control that looks functional and does nothing, which is
worse than the placeholder it replaces.

exemptions.rust:placeholder: THE SENTINEL, not a widget kind. `placeholder` is what the canonical set calls the fallback a port renders for an unknown or undispatched kind; dispatching it would be circular. Exempt in every port, permanently. (This is also the 37-vs-38 discrepancy between two independent counts of the same list.)
exemptions.swift:placeholder: THE SENTINEL. As rust:placeholder -- permanent, not debt.
exemptions.swift:dropdown: REAL GAP, and larger than a dispatch arm: the Layers panel's element-type filter is UNBUILT in JasSwift. jas_dioxus backs it with native `AppState.layers_hidden_types` plus tree filtering (renderer.rs ~8900); JasSwift has neither the state nor the filtering. Adding only the arm would open a menu that changes nothing. Artist-visible today as the literal placeholder text 'Filter by element type' beside the Layers search box -- which appeared in a screenshot to the Captain on 2026-07-29 and was read by nobody. Found by the jas/windows seat counting dispatch arms.
exemptions.swift:icon_button_group: REAL GAP. The Artboard Options orientation control (portrait/landscape). The widget is absent AND so is the action its behaviour dispatches -- `toggle_artboard_orientation` does not exist in JasSwift, though it is declared in workspace/dialogs/artboard_options.yaml. Both halves are needed; the arm alone would present a working-looking toggle that no-ops.
exemptions.swift:reference_point_widget: REAL GAP. The Artboard Options 3x3 anchor grid ('exactly one anchor active; changes X / Y display, not storage'). As icon_button_group: the widget is absent AND `set_artboard_reference_point` does not exist in JasSwift. Needs the artboard reference-point model, not a switch case.
